svg.title: Heat, mass, temperature change, and substance
svg.desc: (a) Doubling the heat transferred to the same mass doubles its temperature change: Q gives ΔT, Q′ = 2Q gives 2ΔT. (b) Twice the heat is needed to give twice the mass the same temperature change ΔT. (c) For the same mass and temperature change, water needs 10.8 times as much heat as copper.
